correctness.rationale: The repaired result preserves the exact rate-sweep theorem. The stationary position is the contracting active convolution plus independent isotropic Gaussian noise; the cross fourth moments cancel against twice the squared second moment, and the pure Gaussian bracket vanishes. In trap units the mode index m=q−p makes the active generator triangular in polynomial degree; the two-state block has determinant (p+q+m²)(p+q+m²+2r)+m²u²>0. Independent exact replay /workspace/branches/31cc3a24-589f-46c7-af4f-7c267601e938/moment_certificate.py reconstructs both moments and verifies the rational cumulant, the specialization of the broader formula and the witness 55/1446336; the supplied script was inspected but not run. For r≤1/4 the numerator P is strictly positive; for r>1/4 it changes sign across a unique positive root in x=u². That root diverges at both ends of r∈(1/4,∞) (asymptotic 7r² at infinity), so it has an attained minimum x_c. Strict P_rr>0 on r≥0 and positivity at the two r boundaries yield exactly one double root at onset and two simple roots above. The discriminant at x=64 and negative witness at x=81 enclose the onset rigorously; only the printed decimal tangency location is numerical. Rescaling r=1/4+c/u² gives the simple limiting root c=455/64 by the implicit function theorem, and scaling r=yu gives the nonzero simple root of 28y³−4y at y=1/√7. Root signs and the two-root count select the respective branches. No conclusions about density modality follow.
